info.name: Mart - Auth (members)
info.description: Run the whole collection (Collection Runner) with the backend running on {{baseUrl}}. The Backend always answers HTTP 200 and tells success/failure with login/regist/update/upload and message in the body. Registers a new autotest_* account each run (delete them afterwards).

exec: pm.test("role is member (admin request ignored)", () => pm.expect(j.role).to.eql("member"))
pm.test("sets httpOnly cookie", () => { const c = pm.response.headers.get("Set-Cookie") || ""; pm.expect(c).to.include("token="); pm.expect(c).to.include("HttpOnly") })

item.name: Login - unknown email (same message as wrong password)

exec: pm.test("message has: name is required", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("name is required"))
pm.test("fields updated", () => { pm.expect(j.name).to.eql("Edited Name"); pm.expect(j.phone).to.eql("0812345678"); pm.expect(j.address).to.eql("1 Test Road") })

item.name: Detail - shows edited data from DB

exec: pm.test("has total and data", () => { pm.expect(j.total).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an("array") })
pm.test("message has: role must be", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("role must be"))
pm.test("message has: status must be", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("status must be"))

item.name: Status - id is not a number

exec: pm.test("message has: id must be a number", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("id must be a number"))
pm.test("message has: Member not found", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Member not found"))
pm.test("message has: cannot change your own", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("cannot change your own"))
pm.test("message has: role must be", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("role must be"))
